headline: Brazil Cruise Season Expects Over BRL 4 Billion in Revenue
summary: Brazil's 2026/2027 cruise season opened with a 24 percent increase in berths, with the Ministry of Tourism projecting BRL 4.72 billion in revenue and over 72,000 generated jobs.
why: Coastal tourism activity and cruise line operations provide material seasonal revenue contributions to the service sector and local economies along Brazil's coastline.

impacts.name: Brazilian Tourism Sector
impacts.why: Expanded cruise capacity directly increases hospitality and tourism revenues.
